svg.title: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect complete sequence
svg.desc: A single snapshot of all 22 handoffs from client registration through sign-in, token validation, application session, API access, optional UserInfo and refresh, and logout.
svg.metadata: Embedded DM Sans and Domine fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. License notices are in public/font-licenses.
svg.text: The complete sign-in and access sequence
OAuth 2.0 authorization code + PKCE, OIDC identity, and the application session
Map Alex to a local user
Log out and revoke as needed
Optional UserInfo and refresh depend on the grant and tokens issued. App logout, provider logout, and revocation are separate actions.
Illustrative backend flow • Identity Evolution Lab
